settings.heading: Everything You Need to Know About Microneedling

settings.text:
Microneedling, also known as skin needling or collagen-induction therapy, creates tiny injuries to help your skin heal naturally. We usually suggest 3 to 6 sessions. You should space these 4 to 6 weeks apart. Thereafter, you need to perform occasional maintenance to keep collagen levels high.

  • Fades Scars & Stretch Marks: Breaks up old scar tissue for a more even texture.
  • Shrinks Pores & Balances Tone: Refines skin for a filtered-in-real-life finish.
  • SuperCharges Skincare Absorption: Active ingredients penetrate up to 80 % better post-treatment.
  • Book online, earn loyalty points, and relax. Our experts customise needle depth, serum blends, and treatment schedules to meet your skin goals.

settings.heading: What to Expect Before, During & After Treatment

settings.text:
• Pre-Treatment: Arrive with clean skin; avoid retinoids, AHAs/BHAs & sun for 5 days. Hydrate well and skip anti-inflammatory meds 24 h prior.
  • During: Numbing cream keeps sensations to gentle tingles; the HydraPen glides while infusing serum. Most sessions wrap in under 45 minutes.
  • Post-Treatment: You may see mild redness, like a sun-kissed look, for 12 to 48 hours. Tiny flaking might happen by day 3. Use SPF 50+ and skip makeup for 24 hours. Apply Deluxe hyaluronic serum to help calm your skin quickly.
  • Long-Term: Collagen works for 3 to 6 months, so your glow keeps improving. Schedule a maintenance boost every 6 to 12 months for lasting results.

settings.heading: What is micro-needling good for?
settings.content: Microneedling is used to treat and improve conditions like acne scarring, fine lines and wrinkles, loose skin, skin texture, pore size, brown spots, stretch marks, and pigment issues. It's also called skin needling, collagen induction therapy (CIT), and percutaneous collagen induction (PCI)

settings.heading: How soon will I see results?
settings.content: You’ll notice a subtle radiance within a week. Deeper improvements in texture and scars emerge progressively, peaking around 3 months after the final session.

settings.heading: Does it hurt?
settings.content: With medical-grade numbing cream and HydraPen’s precise needles, most clients feel a light scratching or vibration. The sensation is generally well-tolerated by clients.

settings.heading: Is micro-needling safe?
settings.content: The medical community generally considers microneedling to be safe and effective, but there are still some risks. The primary risk is skin irritation after the procedure. Other side effects could include: swelling

settings.heading: Is micro-needling permanent?
settings.content: Effects of a microneedling Pen. No skin enhancement procedure is permanent. This is important because a micro-needling pen creates microscopic injuries in the skin in order to stimulate the body's natural healing response. It is the healing process that produces improved-looking skin.

settings.heading: Can my skin be exposed to the sun after the treatment?
settings.content: If being exposed to sun after microneedling treatment, wear a Hat for at least 2 days post treatment.

settings.heading: Can I wash my face after micro-needling?
settings.content: Use a very gentle cleanser and tepid water to rinse the face over the next 72 hours. Gently dry the microneedling treated area after rinsing and make sure your hands are as clean as possible.

settings.heading: How long does redness last after micro-needling?
settings.content: The inflammatory reaction of the skin is extremely short and fades significantly within hours from redness to pinkish that may last for 12 to 48 hours. In order to reduce visible redness, we recommend LED treatment after the procedure, and to protect the skin use a chemical free sunblock if being exposed to sun.

settings.heading: Do you peel after micro-needling?
settings.content: It is normal for the skin to peel after microneedling treatments within a few days. A new layer of skin is produced and the old skin begins peeling off. The peeling will be minimal, similar to a mild sunburn. This will subside within a few days, leaving you with a youthful, glowing look and feel.

settings.heading: How long after micro-needling until I can wear makeup?
settings.content: If you have microneedling performed on your face, you'll have to wait 2 to 3 days to begin wearing makeup again, depending on the unique post-procedure instructions that your skin expert has provided you after your session.

settings.heading: How often should micro-needling be done?
settings.content: Microneedling can be safely repeated every 4-6 weeks until you achieve the desired results. For collagen induction we recommend to start with 3 treatments, but with a minimum separation time of 4 to 6 weeks between treatments. For scar reduction an average of 3 to 6 treatments are recommended.

settings.heading: Is microneedling safe for darker skin tones?
settings.content: Yes. Microneedling is safe for most Fitzpatrick skin types. It has a low risk of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation because the needles do not affect the epidermal pigment.

settings.heading: Can I combine this with other treatments?
settings.content: Absolutely. You can strategically time chemical peels, LED therapy, or laser facials for synergistic results—talk to your therapist about a tailored plan.

settings.heading: How much does it cost?
settings.content: Pricing depends on the area(s) treated and the number of sessions. Multi-zone packages and subscription plans lock in the best rates—ask us for today’s specials.
